name: @pipeworx/mcp-peru-sunat-ruc

tools.name: pe_ruc
tools.description: Look up one Peruvian taxpayer by its 11-digit RUC in SUNAT's published taxpayer register: registered name (razon social), taxpayer status (active, deregistered, suspended ...), domicile condition (habido / no habido ...) and, for companies, the registered address with its ubigeo and department. Companies and organisations only (RUC prefix 20, plus government offices 00): natural persons (RUCs beginning 10, 15, 17) are excluded and answer found:false with reason natural_person_not_served, no name, status or address. Use for "is RUC 20100070970 real and active", KYC and counterparty checks, or resolving a RUC found on an invoice.

tools.name: pe_ruc_search
tools.description: Search SUNAT's published taxpayer register by company name (razon social) -- legal entities only (RUC prefix 20 and government offices); natural persons are excluded entirely and are never returned. Accent-insensitive substring match: every word of 3+ letters must appear in the name. Active registrations are listed before deregistered ones. Optionally restrict to a place with a ubigeo prefix (2 digits = department, e.g. "15" Lima; 4 = province; 6 = district). Returns RUC, name, status and address so you can pick the right one.

name.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "BANCO DE CREDITO" or "alicorp".

ubigeo.description: Optional ubigeo prefix: 2, 4 or 6 digits (e.g. "15" Lima department, "150122" Miraflores).

active_only.description: If true, return only registrations whose status is ACTIVO (default false: active first, then the rest).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-peru-sunat-ruc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the peru-sunat-ruc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
